claims: T.J. Otzelberger is the head men's basketball coach at Iowa State University.
T.J. Otzelberger has held the position since March 2021.
T.J. Otzelberger was hired on March 18, 2021.
T.J. Otzelberger was hired as the 21st head coach in Iowa State University men's basketball program history.
T.J. Otzelberger has led the Cyclones to Sweet 16 appearances in 2022 and 2024.
As of March 2026, T.J. Otzelberger has led the team to over 90 wins in his first four years.
Over 90 wins in the first four years is the most in Iowa State school history for that span.
Before joining Iowa State, Otzelberger was the head coach at South Dakota State.
Otzelberger had previous assistant coaching roles at Iowa State under Greg McDermott.
Otzelberger had previous assistant coaching roles at Iowa State under Fred Hoiberg.
Otzelberger had previous assistant coaching roles at Iowa State under Steve Prohm.
T.J. Otzelberger is currently leading the Cyclones in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
